name: calathea
note: Round leaves banded with silver along the veins.
enters: Low in the bed, in front
grows: The rosette opens leaf by leaf

name: monstera
note: A broad heart split from the margin and pierced along the midrib.
grows: Stalks rise, then leaves unfurl

name: strelitzia
note: Long paddles in a fan, torn by the wind, and one crane flower on its own stalk.
grows: Paddles rise in turn, and the flower opens last

name: palm
note: Pleated, nearly round fans on long toothed stalks.
grows: Stalks extend, then each fan opens

name: alocasia
note: Dark arrowheads with scalloped edges and silver veins.
grows: Stalks rise, and leaves tilt open

name: staghorn
note: Shield fronds over a hanging basket, and broad antler fronds that fork into rounded lobes.
grows: Antler fronds unfold one by one

name: philodendron
note: Glossy hearts, some streaked with lime, on a trailing stem.
grows: The stem lengthens downward, and hearts unfold

name: adansonii
note: Small leaves full of oval holes on a wandering stem.
grows: The stem extends, and leaves unfold behind the tip

name: bauhinia
note: Two-lobed butterfly leaves on a slender branch, and orchid-like flowers with fine curving stamens.
grows: The branch extends, leaves open, and flowers come last

name: lychee
note: Drooping leaves of glossy leaflets and a hanging cluster of pebbled rose-red fruit.
grows: The limb extends, leaves unfold, and the fruit drops last

name: mango
note: Loose clusters of smooth leathery leaves, and mangoes ripening from green to gold.
grows: The limb extends, clusters open, and the fruit swells last

name: frangipani
note: Thick, smooth limbs that end blunt, spiral rosettes of broad leaves, and pinwheel flowers warming to yellow at the heart.
grows: The limb extends and forks, rosettes open, and flowers come last

name: cypress
note: Two dark flames of upward sprays, catching the moon along one side.
grows: Each column grows up from its base

name: acanthus
note: The glossy, deeply lobed leaf of the Corinthian capital, and a tall spike of pale flowers under purple hoods.
grows: Leaves open, the spike rises, and its flowers open from the bottom up

name: agave
note: A rosette of thick blue-grey leaves with toothed edges, dark tips, and the pale prints of their neighbors.
grows: Leaves open from the center outward

name: lavender
note: A grey-green mound and a fan of slender stems, each tipped with violet whorls.
grows: The mound fills in, then the stems lift their spikes

name: rosemary
note: Upright woody stems dense with needle leaves, dark above and silver below, and pale blue flowers.
grows: Stems rise one by one

name: grapevine
note: A woody cane from the pergola, serrated leaves, curling tendrils, and dusky bunches with a pale bloom.
grows: The cane lengthens downward, leaves unfold, and the bunches hang last

name: jasmine
note: Twining stems, small glossy leaves in pairs, and white pinwheel flowers that open at night.
grows: Stems lengthen, leaves unfold, and flowers open last

name: bougainvillea
note: Thorny canes arching out and down, heavy with papery magenta bracts in threes.
grows: Canes arch out, leaves unfold, and the bracts open last

name: pine
note: Plated red-brown bark, long needles bursting in tufts, and broad scaled cones.
grows: The limb extends, tufts burst open, and cones come last

name: fig
note: A smooth grey branch, broad lobed leaves, and pear-shaped figs, violet with a green neck.
grows: The branch extends, leaves open at the tips, and figs swell last

name: lemon
note: A slender thorny branch, glossy leaves, lemons that glow in the dark, and waxy blossom flushed purple.
grows: The branch extends, leaves unfold, lemons hang, and blossom opens last

name: olive
note: A gnarled silver branch, narrow leaves dark above and silver beneath, and olives ripening to violet-black.
grows: The branch extends, twigs leaf out, and olives come last

name: saguaro
note: A pleated column, arms lifting like raised hands, white flowers crowning every tip.
grows: The trunk rises, arms bend up from it at the knee, and the tips flower last

name: opuntia
note: Flat pads stacked into a sprawling clump, yellow cups and magenta fruit along their rims.
grows: Pads bud from pads, then flowers open and fruit swells

name: ferocactus
note: Squat ribbed barrels leaning toward the sun, a red hook at the heart of every areole, a crown of flowers.
grows: Each barrel swells from its base, and the crown flowers last

name: paloverde
note: A green-barked branch in a haze of tiny leaflets and yellow flowers, hung with clumps of desert mistletoe (Phoradendron californicum).
grows: The branch extends and forks, twigs leaf out, and flowers and mistletoe berries come last

name: ocotillo
note: Bare thorned whips fanning from one crown, small leaves at the thorns, a scarlet spike at every tip.
grows: The canes rise from the crown, leaves come in flushes, and the spikes flower last

name: organpipe
note: Ribbed columns rising together from one base, leaning out and turning up, pale pink flowers at a few tips.
grows: The columns rise one after another, and the tips flower last

name: brittlebush
note: A mound of silver felted leaves, and long bare stalks holding yellow daisies above it.
grows: The leaves open into a mound, the stalks rise, and the daisies open last

name: mesquite
note: A dark twisting branch, feathery leaves of many tiny leaflets, paired thorns, yellow catkins, and hanging pods.
grows: The branch extends and forks, leaves open at the nodes, then catkins and pods

name: cholla
note: Jointed arms wrapped in pale spines that catch the light, and chains of green fruit hanging from the older joints.
grows: The trunk rises, joints bud from joints, and the fruit chains hang last

name: creosote
note: An open vase of thin forking stems, tiny paired leaflets, small yellow flowers, and white seed balls.
grows: The stems rise and fork, leaflets follow, then flowers and seed balls

name: ibervillea
note: A gourd vine trailing in along the ground, deeply lobed leaves, coiled tendrils, and round red fruit.
enters: Trails in from a side, along the ground
grows: The vine runs in, leaves and tendrils follow it, and the fruit ripens last

name: trimera
note: A low shrub's grey twiggy branch, its tiny sticky light-green leaves packed into rounded clumps, and small bells that open white and age to brown.
grows: The branch extends and forks, and the clumps leaf out along it

name: groundsel
note: A trunk forked into a candelabra, every tip a metre-wide rosette over a skirt of its own dead leaves, the foot bared to cork and crusted with orange lichen; a spent panicle hangs from one rosette.
grows: The trunk rises in its skirt and forks, and each rosette opens leaf by leaf

name: sapling
note: Not yet flowered, so not yet branched: one rosette on a column in its skirt of dead leaves, leaning in from beyond the frame.
enters: Leans in from a bottom corner
grows: The column rises in its skirt, and the rosette opens leaf by leaf

name: telekii
note: One rosette of narrow blue-green leaves under a shaggy column of long hairy bracts that hide its blue-purple flowers.
grows: The rosette opens, the column rises, and its bracts unfold up it

name: cabbage
note: Rosettes at ground level, every leaf felted creamy white beneath, and a narrow cone of nodding yellow-rayed heads.
grows: The rosettes open leaf by leaf, then the cone rises and its heads nod open

name: heath
note: A red-brown branch in ascending plumes of needle leaves and white bells, draped with pale strands of beard lichen (Usnea articulata).
grows: The branch extends and forks, plumes rise along it, and the lichen hangs last

name: thistle
note: A rosette of lobed, spine-tipped leaves cobwebbed with white hair, a stem with interrupted spiny wings, and clusters of mauve heads.
grows: The rosette spreads, the winged stem rises, and the heads open last

name: alchemilla
note: A shrub of slender arching stems, silver all over, clothed in tiny three-lobed leaves.
grows: The stems arch out and leaf as they go

name: gregoriana
note: Shiny rosettes on short stems mantled in dead leaves, a narrow spike whose flowers show between its bracts, and last year's spike standing dead.
grows: The rosettes open, then the spike rises and flowers up its length

name: helichrysum
note: A grey cushion of short woolly-leaved stems, and clusters of papery cream heads flushed pink at the base.
grows: The cushion fills out, and the heads open last

name: tussock
note: A dense fountain of fine blades, the old ones bleached to straw, and a few thin panicles above.
grows: The blades fountain up, and the panicles rise last

name: haplocarpha
note: A flat rosette pressed to the ground, glossy above and white-woolly beneath, and yellow daisies on short stalks.
grows: The rosette spreads flat, and the daisies open last

name: marula
note: A grey trunk mottled where its bark flakes, leaning in, and a dense rounded crown of pinnate leaves.
enters: Leans in from a bottom corner
grows: The trunk rises and forks, and the leaves crowd the branch ends

name: baobab
note: A swollen grey trunk, smooth and folded, thick limbs thrust up like roots, new palmate leaves at the twig tips, and big white flowers hanging on long stalks.
grows: The trunk swells up, the limbs thrust out and fork, leaves crowd the twig tips, and the flowers hang last

name: kigelia
note: A smooth grey branch, a rounded crown of pinnate leaves, and last season's long grey fruit hanging on rope-like stalks.
grows: The branch extends and forks, the leaves cluster at its tips, and the fruit hangs last

name: thorn
note: Dark zigzag limbs reaching out to one level under a flat crown of fine leaves, thorns in pairs, white ball flowers, and coiled pods.
grows: The branch extends, its limbs zigzag out to the crown, the tiers leaf out, and the flowers open last

name: thatchgrass
note: A leafy tuft under tall straight culms, each with a loose panicle of small golden racemes.
grows: The tuft fills out, and the culms rise last

name: redgrass
note: A tuft of narrow blades, and culms holding drooping clusters of rust-red spikelets with kinked awns.
grows: The tuft fills out, and the culms rise and nod last

name: crinum
note: Arching blue-green strap leaves, and on a stalk above them an umbel of white trumpets keeled with pink.
grows: The leaves arch out, the stalk rises, and the trumpets open last

name: gloriosa
note: Thin stems scrambling up through the grass on tendrils at their leaf tips, and nodding plum-red flowers whose wavy tepals sweep back like flames.
grows: The stems climb, the leaves reach out their tendrils, and the flowers open last

name: hypoxis
note: Hairy strap leaves arching out in three ranks, and erect stalks of bright yellow six-pointed stars.
grows: The leaves arch out, and the stalks rise with their stars last

name: pincushion
note: Thick corky limbs branching at wide angles, wedge leaves notched with red-tipped apical teeth, and golden domes of arching styles with conical pollen presenters.
enters: Leans in from a bottom corner
grows: The corky trunk rises and forks, wedge leaves unfold, and the golden style domes arch open last

name: silvertree
note: Stout ascending grey limbs scarred with horizontal leaf rings, shingled in silky silver lance-leaves that flare into terminal rosettes round heavy silver-velvet cones.
grows: The scarred limb extends and forks, silver leaves shingle the shoots, and the terminal rosettes and cones open last

name: sugarbush
note: Woody branches of narrow upright blue-green leaves, V-shaped goblets of pointed cream-to-carmine bracts, old brown cones, and leafless yellow-orange threads of dodder laurel (Cassytha ciliolata) cascading from the limbs.
grows: The branch extends and forks, upright leaves and V-goblets open, and the Cassytha threads cascade last

name: restio
note: A dense fountain of leafless dark-green culms ringed with black node bands, curling golden-chestnut papery sheaths peeling from the nodes, and nodding dark-brown plumes.
grows: The fountain of culms arches out, papery sheaths curl at the nodes, and the brown plumes nod last

name: watsonia
note: An equitant fan of broad sword leaves edged in yellow, and a tall branched spire lined in two opposite ranks with rose-magenta bugle trumpets.
grows: The sword fan spreads, the tall spire and side branches rise, and the trumpets open up their length

name: aristea
note: A stiff fan of narrow ribbed sword leaves and tall rod stems packed along the upper half with sessile clusters of deep gentian-blue six-pointed stars and papery brown spathes.
grows: The leaf fan opens, the rods rise, and the gentian-blue stars unfold up the stems

name: kingprotea
note: Thick red stems clothed in glossy oval leaves on crimson stalks, each crowned by a giant bowl of pointed silky-pink bracts cupped round a snowy-white cone.
grows: The red stems rise, oval leaves unfold up their length, and the giant bract bowls open last

name: pagoda
note: Upright wand stems clad in oval leaves below, crowned by a cylindrical pagoda where scarlet-and-gold folded leaf-hoods cowl over white beards and red style tufts.
grows: The red wands rise, green leaves clothe the base, and the scarlet-and-gold hoods unfold at the top

name: berzelia
note: Soft bottlebrush stems clothed in fine yellow-green needles, topped by corymb clusters of creamy-white spherical pompom heads and reddish fruiting knobs.
grows: The feathery stems rise, and the creamy pompom clusters open at the tips

name: phaenocoma
note: Stiff white-woolly branches studded with bead-like dark-green granular spur shoots, crowned with glossy cerise-magenta papery star-heads.
grows: The white-woolly branches rise with their green bead shoots, and the papery magenta stars open last

name: fireheath
note: Wiry stems clothed in whorls of dark needle leaves, tipped with nodding umbels of swollen, white-hairy crimson-scarlet tubular bells.
grows: The wiry stems rise in needle whorls, and the scarlet tubular umbels nod open last

name: pelargonium
note: Soft-hairy sprawling stems with cupped kidney-shaped toothed leaves and long-stalked umbels of asymmetric orchid-magenta flowers feathered dark purple.
grows: The stems spread their cupped leaves, and the feathered magenta umbels open above them

name: damara
note: A dense hemispherical dome of erect leafless glaucous pencil-thick rods tipped with sessile yellow-brown cyathia and three-lobed capsules.
enters: Leans in from a bottom corner
grows: The pencil rods fan upward from the base, and the yellow-brown cyathia and three-lobed capsules form at the tips

name: buttertree
note: A squat pachycaul trunk with translucent golden-yellow peeling bark over olive underbark, thick forked branches, succulent green paddle leaves, and red-stalked urn panicles.
enters: Leans in from a bottom corner
grows: The swollen trunk and branches extend, peeling bark curls at the edges, and paddle leaves and red-stalked urns open at the tips

name: halfmens
note: An unbranched warty silver-grey column tilting north, armed with three-spined tubercles and crowned by a tilted crest of strongly wavy velvety leaves and red-throated tubular flowers.
grows: The spiny column leans in, the wavy leaf crest unfolds at the apex, and the red-throated tubes open last

name: quivertree
note: A stout tapering trunk plated with golden-brown scales, forking repeatedly in pairs into a rounded crown of compact blue-glaucous rosettes and erect canary-yellow racemes.
grows: The plated trunk rises and forks in pairs, blue-green rosettes open at every tip, and canary-yellow racemes rise last

name: dunegrass
note: A tough dune-anchoring hummock of rigid bamboo-like knotted culms bent by wind and topped by narrow feathery silver-cream plumose panicles.
grows: The knotted culms arch in the wind, and the feathery silver-cream plumes unfurl at the tips

name: gifboom
note: A candelabra whorl of constricted five-to-eight-angled ribbed stems armed with paired stipular spines on continuous grey shields, hosting a woody clump of Namibian mistletoe (Tapinanthus oleifolius) with crimson-red split-tube flowers.
grows: The constricted spiny ribs rise from the twisted base, and the mistletoe clump opens its crimson tubes on the upper stems

name: nara
note: A leafless thorny mound of grooved grey-green stems armed with paired straight ivory-tipped spines at every node, pale greenish-yellow axillary flowers, and globose spiny orange-yellow melons.
grows: The grooved thorny stems arch out, paired spines arm the nodes, and the spiny golden melons swell near the base

name: welwitschia
note: A low corky bi-lobed crater crown issuing two broad leathery olive-russet straps that arch out, split lengthwise into frayed ribbons over the gravel, and frame forked scarlet-and-salmon four-ranked cone panicles.
grows: The corky crown settles, the two broad straps unroll and fray over the ground, and the forked salmon-red cone panicles rise from the rim

name: hoodia
note: A tight upright cluster of multi-ribbed grey-tan succulent cylinders studded with spiny tubercles and crowned near the apex by flat five-angled flesh-pink saucer corollas.
grows: The ribbed spiny cylinders rise in a cluster, and the five-angled flesh-pink saucers open flat at the top

name: bushmanscandle
note: A dwarf waxy-barked spiny shrublet of pale-grey branches armed with petiolar spines, small crenate glaucous leaves, and crinkly translucent sulphur-yellow five-petalled saucer flowers.
grows: The waxy spiny branches spread, small glaucous leaves unfold, and the crinkly sulphur-yellow saucers open last

name: lithops
note: Clumps of cordate, convex pearl-grey and bone-ochre fused pebble leaf pairs split by a shallow cleft, with five-chambered seed capsules nestled in the gravel.
grows: The paired stone leaves swell from the gravel, and the five-chambered capsules open in the clefts

name: whitemangrove
note: An open ascending branch of opposite rounded-oblong yellow-green blades on carmine-red petioles with paired sub-blade salt glands, and axillary spikes of small cream flowers and ten-ribbed obovoid samaras.
enters: Reaches in from a side as the tide rises
grows: The lenticellate branch extends from the margin, biglandular red-petioled leaves open in pairs, and the ribbed samara spikes form at the tips

name: buttonwood
note: A dark fissured limb from the landward rim bearing spirally alternate acute leaves on green and silvery-sericeous shoots and branched panicles of globose scale-tessellated reddish-brown button cones.
enters: Reaches in from a side as the tide rises
grows: The dark limb forks inward, alternate green and silver-felted leaves unfold, and the globose button cones cluster at the ends

name: spanishmoss
note: Rootless silvery-grey peltate-scaly festoons cascading from an upper canopy host bough in pendulous zig-zagging threads of curved filiform leaves and tiny chartreuse flowers.
enters: Dips in on an upper canopy bough and cascades down
grows: The host bough dips from the upper canopy, zig-zagging silvery threads lengthen downward, and curly filiform scales unfurl at every node

name: airplant
note: A solitary massive cream-green tank rosette of spreading recurved blades with castaneous basal sheaths perched on an upper canopy limb, issuing a laxly branched crimson-bracted panicle of tubular violet-and-cream flowers.
enters: Perches on an upper canopy bough and arches down
grows: The canopy bough enters from above, the recurved tank-rosette blades fan outward, and the branched crimson panicle arches down

name: blackmangrove
note: A dark fissured trunk and ascending crown of opposite lance-elliptic leaves—glossy dark green above and silvery salt-crusted beneath—with white four-lobed flower spikes, lima-bean propagules, and a horizontal mud cable root bristling with erect pencil pneumatophores across the waterline.
enters: Rooted in the intertidal mudflat, leaning in from the margin
grows: The mud cable root spreads and sends up erect breathing pegs across the rising waterline while the bicolored crown and flower spikes open above

name: redmangrove
note: A leaning grey-barked trunk lifted above the tidal lagoon on multi-order russet-red catenary stilt-root arches and plumb-vertical aerial drop roots, crowned by opposite glossy dark-green elliptic leaves, four-pointed lemon-yellow star cymes, and pendulous viviparous pencil propagules.
enters: Rooted in the lagoon, leaning in from the side
grows: The catenary stilt-root arcade anchors in the mud, the tide rises across the roots on scroll, and the leathery leaves, yellow star cymes, and pendulous pencil propagules unfold in the crown

name: cordgrass
note: An intertidal saltmarsh colony of smooth erect culms rising through the brackish water, long flat tapering leaf blades arching to one side, and narrow panicles of closely appressed one-sided spikes.
enters: Rises through the lagoon water in the bed
grows: The smooth culms rise through the tide, tapering blades arch out, and the appressed one-sided spike panicles emerge at the tips

name: leatherfern
note: A tall erect V-clump of stiff 1-pinnate leathery fronds with closely spaced oblong-lanceolate pinnae, mixing sterile dark-green fronds with fertile fronds coated beneath in velvety golden-rust sporangia.
grows: Stout rachises unroll upward from the lagoon floor, and closely ranked sterile green and fertile golden-rust pinnae unfold pair by pair

name: swamplily
note: An emergent brackish-water bulb clump of arching channeled green strap leaves and stout scapes crowned by umbels of fragrant white six-tepaled spider flowers with long spreading crimson-purple stamen filaments.
enters: Rises from the lagoon floor in the bed
grows: Channeled strap leaves arch out from the bulb, stout scapes rise above the water, and the white spider-lily umbels unfurl their crimson stamens

name: morningglory
note: Long prostrate purplish-red stolons creeping across the shore margin with upright succulent bilobed goat's-foot leaves and rose-violet funnel corollas marked by a five-rayed magenta star throat.
enters: Creeps in along the shore margin in the bed
grows: The prostrate stolons trail across the berm, notched goat's-foot leaves lift at the nodes, and the rose-violet funnels open

name: saltwort
note: A low succulent subshrub of arching stems sending up erect shoots clothed in decussate pairs of plump club-shaped chartreuse leaves and sessile axillary cones.
enters: Low on the tidal flat in the bed
grows: The succulent shoots rise over the mudflat, plump club-shaped leaf pairs swell in opposite ranks, and small green cones form in the axils

name: seapurslane
note: A prostrate succulent mat of fleshy carmine-red stems hugging the tidal mud, opposite glossy jade-green spatulate blades, and solitary five-pointed rose-pink star calyces.
enters: Creeping low across the mud in the bed
grows: The carmine-red stems spread across the mud, fleshy spatulate leaf pairs open, and five-pointed pink star flowers bloom in the axils
